name: Frida Fahnenlage
personality: She can turn any breeze into evidence that the crowd agrees.
visual_intent: Tall curving comma ink blob,lashed confident eyes and wicked CLOSED smile;rust-red headband with small cream knot,cream wristwrap;holds ONE modest red-cream triangular pennant on short thick wooden stick,other hand at flank
biography: She can turn any breeze into evidence that the crowd agrees. Her pennant makes every corridor breeze look like a public endorsement. The building recognises only our side and theirs. A dissonant card has persuaded her to hold the flag high enough to shelter a neighbour without checking their scarf. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Fahne zeigt Zustimmung. Die Windrichtung wurde nicht befragt.

name: Opa OhneAbpfiff
personality: He remembers when disappointment still had standards.
visual_intent: Very broad low scalloped ink blob,heavy weary lids and long toothless frown;red wool cap,small cream collar;both hands stretch a SHORT rolled red-cream scarf under chin,not over face,full scarfwithin cell
biography: He remembers when disappointment still had standards. His scarf preserves a history of disappointment that newer residents keep mistaking for pessimism. HyperNorm classifies memory as tradition or obstruction. A contradictory card has made him tell a child about the pleasant afternoons between the results. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Früher war die Enttäuschung wenigstens verlässlich.

name: Kalle Klapperrecht
personality: He considers volume a form of democratic procedure.
visual_intent: Round star-lobed ink blob with high asymmetric crest,delighted manic white eyes and three-upper-tooth open shout;small red collar;holds ONE vintage wooden ratchet noise-maker clearly modeled as wheel-and-handle toy,free palm high
biography: He considers volume a form of democratic procedure. He turns the wooden ratchet whenever the building asks for a show of support. People are either audible or absent. An ambiguous card about listening has made him lower it when the neighbour beside him begins to speak. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Abstimmung ist laut. Eine Auszählung erübrigt sich.

name: Egon Ersatzauge
personality: He can see the injustice clearly as soon as somebody points it out.
visual_intent: Narrow crooked pear ink blob,uneven brows,huge uncertain eyes and small CLOSED nervous mouth;cream flatcap with redband,tiny red scarf;holds squat brass binoculars at CHEST wellbelow eyes,one hand shading brow
biography: He can see the injustice clearly as soon as somebody points it out. His binoculars remain below his eyes while he waits for somebody to identify the offending detail. HyperNorm divides events into fair or against us. A dissonant card has made him look at the other spectators instead of the officials. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Ungerechtigkeit ist sichtbar. Der genaue Ort folgt.

name: Paul Platzbeleg
personality: He has paid to belong and expects the universe to honour the receipt.
visual_intent: Wide tall domed ink blob with little split crest,half-lidded suspicious eyes and compressed toothless pout;small red collar and cream cuffbands;holds ONE giant blank torn ticket with simple edge perforations,other hand folded possessively on it
biography: He has paid to belong and expects the universe to honour the receipt. He carries the torn ticket as proof that belonging was purchased properly. Residents are either entitled or standing in someone else's place. A contradictory card has made him move aside for a neighbour whose ticket was lost. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Platz gehört ihm. Die Aussicht wurde leider nicht zugesichert.

name: Nina Nachschall
personality: She brought enthusiasm and is alarmed by how loudly it came out.
visual_intent: Slim upright reverse-comma ink blob,sidequiff with small redbow,subtle lashes,huge startled white eyes and small toothless oval gasp;tiny cream neckerchief;holds ONE short crooked brass fan horn by side pointing downward,not at another actor
biography: She brought enthusiasm and is alarmed by how loudly it came out. The little brass horn seemed a manageable way to participate until it answered her. HyperNorm files newcomers as enthusiastic or disappointing. An ambiguous card has given her permission to enjoy the crowd without matching its loudest member. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie wollte mitmachen. Die Lautstärke war nicht Teil der Einweisung.
